name: WARNING: Taqueria Chiles Toreados & Pickled Escabeche (Jalapeños & Raw Carrots)
whyItWorks: Found on salsa bars: blistered jalapeños (toreados) and pickled escabeche containing rock-hard crunchy raw carrot wheels, jalapeño rings with hard seeds, and raw onions in vinegar. Severe stricture obstruction and capsaicin trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Do not take items from the taqueria pickle bar.
